|rulings=* (Lost function) If Dark's draws and Light's draws add up to the same total, neither player has a lower total, and so neither player will be at risk of losing 6 Force to [[Sith Fury]].<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Sith%20Fury</ref>
* (Lost function) If Dark only has 1 card in Reserve Deck (or Light only has 2 cards in Reserve Deck), they still draw destiny and may still have the higher total. But if a player has 0 cards in Reserve Deck, they have no [[Sith Fury]] total and lose automatically (unless both players have 0 cards in Reserve Deck, in which case it is a tie and neither player will be at risk of losing 6 Force to [[Sith Fury]]).
